description: This file contains the source code for the Chart.js library, specifically version 2.7.3. It includes the core implementation, plugin architecture, various chart types (bar, line, pie, doughnut, etc.), controllers, elements, scales, helpers, and default configurations for creating dynamic, animated charts in web applications.

classes.name: Chart

classes.name: Chart.helpers
classes.description: A collection of utility functions used throughout Chart.js.

classes.name: Chart
classes.description: Main class for creating, updating, and rendering charts, handling all aspects of chart lifecycle, layout, data, and interactions.

classes.name: Chart.DatasetController

classes.name: LinearRadialScale
classes.description: A specialized scale class extending the base linear scale to handle radial coordinate systems, including computation of point positions, radii, and angles, as well as rendering grid lines and labels around a circle.

classes.name: TimeScale
classes.description: A specialized scale class extending the base Scale to handle time-based data, including timestamp generation, label formatting, tick calculation, and position mapping for time axes in charts.
